name: heirloom-of-natura-draw-ability-pays-three-and-banishes-itself
notes: Heirloom of Natura: '(3), Banish: draw a card into your memory' (second ability). The (3) used to be free.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Heirloom of Natura's "(3), Banish: Draw a card into your memory" cost was never paid: ActivatedAbilityCost() had no entry for it (or only banished the card), so the ability was free. Fix: ActivatedAbilityCost() banishes the card and queues the reserve payments.
